description: Read the U.S. Geological Survey's water data for thousands of rivers, streams, lakes and wells across the United States: find monitoring sites, get the latest streamflow, water level and water temperature, read readings and daily values for any period, compare today with what is normal for the date, check gages against nearby flood levels, and get groundwater levels, water quality samples and river camera images. No account or API key required.
